summary: Oracle's force majeure notice on Project Jupiter shows how an AI campus can slip. This brief tracks whether that strain travels from data-center construction to chip stocks to the S&P 500.
watch: SMH closing below its 10% correction line, and Census data-center construction spending stalling or falling.

summary: Oil was above $100 at the Fed's first rate hike. This brief tracks WTI crude against that $100 line and the 10-year Treasury yield against 5%, because higher oil pushes prices up and keeps rates high.
watch: WTI closing above $100, and the 10-year yield moving above 5%.

summary: Treasury has to sell more debt at auction. This brief tracks whether that strain travels from Treasury borrowing to 10-year auction demand to mortgage rates.
watch: A 10-year auction bid-to-cover below its 6-auction average, and the 30-year mortgage rate above its 13-week average.

summary: The 30-year Treasury yield is the rate the government pays to borrow for 30 years. This brief tracks whether it reaches 6% and stays there through a long-term borrowing date, which would raise the cost of new government debt and mortgages.
watch: The 30-year closing above 5.75%, then 6%, and holding there through a long-term borrowing date.
